title: Notify the step counter
hints: A task notification works like a counter built into the task. Give adds 1. Take waits until the counter is non-zero, and the first parameter decides whether take clears the counter or decrements it.

In the ISR, call `vTaskNotifyGiveFromISR(g_imu_task, &xHigherPriorityTaskWoken);` and keep the yield. In the task, call `ulTaskNotifyTake(pdFALSE, IMU_SILENCE_TIMEOUT)`: it returns the count before decrementing, or 0 on timeout.
The task loop is: `if (ulTaskNotifyTake(pdFALSE, IMU_SILENCE_TIMEOUT) == 0) { g_timeouts++; continue; } read_one_fifo_sample();`. Then delete `g_imu_sem` and the `xSemaphoreCreateBinary()` call.
